review_decisions: Use the original 2006 bat-order wording in unlock instructions, consistent with current team-selection labels; the 2026 Home/Away terms are contextual references rather than an automatic replacement.
Keep original-period venue and uniform names, including generic Municipal Stadium separately from Hiroshima Municipal.
Preseason evaluations concern starter plate appearances and the first three innings after a pitcher enters; do not turn this into three innings from the start of the game.
Preserve three preseason games, up to five partners, star costs, per-turn guest replacement and special-card turnover.
Preserve partner levels, ability-steal difficulty, group-training links and training-card bonuses as separate effects.
Keep the original Breaking Balls category for the source 変化球; the official Pitch Type references use 球種 and do not alone prove this category should be renamed.
Wallpaper A/B variants remain distinct and the original ballpark artwork, signs and ads are unchanged.
layout_estimate_scope: Arial 16 px advances; original renderer strings remain relocated through the existing lookup. Actual shop widgets and assembled tutorial rows still need live layout checks.
pending: Live Spirits tutorial row placement, transitions and shop unlock-description fit.
